name: acom-flex-bridge
description: Translator, telemetry, and dashboard bridging an ACOM 700S/06AT to a FlexRadio FLEX-8400 via the native SmartSDR TCP API. Works alongside SmartSDR, AetherSDR, or Maestro.

scripts.ports: node -e "require('serialport').SerialPort.list().then(p => console.table(p.map(x => ({path: x.path, manufacturer: x.manufacturer, serial: x.serialNumber}))))"
